subject: Inletix security kickoff — SOC 2 / SIG scheduling & artifact handshake
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@inletix.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@inletix.com, priya.rao@inletix.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intro — SOC 2 / SIG kickoff request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing for a SOC 2 assessment and a SIG/CAIQ review; security asked me to line up a kickoff so we can hand off an evidence map and discuss log sampling windows.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Redwood prefers SIG or CAIQ as the starting questionnaire (we can provide both).
- Walk through log retention and export options for hosted API usage.
- Agree an artifact handoff method and a preliminary list of owners.

Are you available for a 30–45m call next week? We prefer Thu/Mar 4 in the morning (PST).

Attaching our vendor intake form for reference.

Alex Mercer
Director, IT Security
Inletix

Attachments: inletix-vendor-intake.pdf (pdf)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@inletix.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro — SOC 2 / SIG kickoff request

Alex — thanks for the note and the intake file. Happy to coordinate. Quick answers up front:
- We typically start with the SIG in parallel with a CAIQ mapping for engineering teams; SIG gives the granular control-plane view that customers find actionable. We can run both.
- Log retention/export: hosted API has two relevant paths (1) per-request telemetry logs exported via S3 (90-day default, longer via enterprise contract) and (2) aggregated request/latency metrics available in the Console. We'll capture options on the call.

Proposed times (PST):
- Thu Mar 4 09:00–09:45
- Thu Mar 4 10:30–11:15
- Fri Mar 5 08:30–09:15

I attached a short intake worksheet that maps common SIG/CAIQ asks to evidence types; please fill the owners column and return before the call if possible. Added Marissa and Ben to help with evidence owners and log sampling technicals.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: inletix-intake-worksheet-v1.xlsx (xlsx), kickoff-agenda-0310.pdf (pdf)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0500
Subject: internal: Inletix kickoff prep notes

Soojin — quick internal prep notes before we lock the slot. Pulling from past intakes, a few likely asks to be ready for:
- Live log samples: Inletix will ask for request/response headers, truncated payload samples, and the KV cache eviction events. They often want proof those samples are redacted.
- Key management: we should be ready to describe KMS/HSM options and any customer-managed key patterns for Private deployments.
- Retention SLAs: clarify default 90-day retention for raw telemetry vs. 365+/archival options for Dedicated/Private.
- CAIQ: expect questions on data classification, third-party subprocessors (list), and the change-control workflow for model rollouts.

Ben — can you draft a 1-page sample spec for log exports (format + redaction rules)? Laura — can you confirm who handles the subprocessors list + contact for infosec attestations?

-Marissa
Principal, Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@inletix.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@inletix.com>, security@inletix.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro — SOC 2 / SIG kickoff request

Thanks — Thu Mar 4 09:00 PST works for us. We'll invite our legal/ops person Priya for procurement context. A couple of pre-call clarifications so we can prepare the right artifacts:
- Log format: We produce newline-delimited JSON with request_id and timestamp — can Redwood accept that as sample input? If not, we can provide flattened CSV.
- Sampling window: can you confirm what range you typically sample for latency anomalies? We usually try to align sample windows across both sides.
- Evidence handoff: would Redwood prefer a secure S3 staging location or use a shared Drive folder? Also note we will need a simple non-disclosure addendum for the uploads — will that come from your legal team?

I'll also attach a short export of our telemetry schema so Ben can comment.

Alex

Attachments: inletix-telemetry-schema.json (json)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@inletix.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0500
Subject: Notes & actions — Inletix kickoff (Thu Mar 4 09:00 PST)

Thanks everyone — good kickoff this morning. Summary and action items below.

Meeting notes (30m):
- Attendees: Alex Mercer (Inletix), Priya Rao (Inletix Legal), Soojin Lee (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood Compliance), Ben Carter (Redwood SE), Laura Bennett (Redwood PM).
- Scope agreed: run a SIG mapping first and maintain a CAIQ reference. Inletix requested both, prioritizing SIG answers that drive procurement.
- Logs: Redwood accepts newline-delimited JSON samples. Ben confirmed required fields: request_id, timestamp, route, response_code, latency_ms, redacted_payload. Redwood will provide a sample schema doc.
- Sampling window: mutual 7-day window for initial sampling focusing on peak traffic hours (Tues–Thurs 10:00–16:00 local).
- Evidence handoff: agreed to use a pre-signed S3 staging bucket. Redwood legal will circulate a short upload NDA (one-way) before artifact transfer.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Alex: populate inletix-intake-worksheet owners column and return (ETA: 2027-03-06).
- Ben: draft log-sample-spec and redact rules doc and upload to shared Drive (ETA: 2027-03-05). Attachment: inletix-log-sample-spec.md (md).
- Laura: export subprocessors list and contact for attestations (ETA: 2027-03-08).
- Marissa / Soojin: Redwood will prepare SIG mapping skeleton and send initial 20-question bundle (ETA: 2027-03-07).
- Redwood Legal (cc Marissa): circulate upload NDA (ETA: 2027-03-05).

Next call: quick follow-up scheduled for Tue Mar 9 09:00 PST to review the sample and initial SIG answers. Calendar invite to follow.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments uploaded to shared Drive: inletix-intake-worksheet-v1.xlsx, kickoff-agenda-0310.pdf, inletix-log-sample-spec.md
